get.summary: Retrieve broken links for a project
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of broken links detected on a project's pages. Supports filtering by HTTP status category, resource type, search text, and ignored state.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search broken links or page URLs by keyword

example.message: "resource_type" must be one of [LINK, IMAGE, SCRIPT, STYLESHEET, IFRAME]

post.description: Marks a broken link as ignored for the specified project. If the link is already ignored, updates the reason.

link_id.description: The ID of the broken link to ignore

example.reason: Known external link, not our responsibility

post.summary: Create a custom work for a project
post.description: Creates a new custom work entry for a specific project. Supports one-time and recurring works.

execution_date.description: Execution date of the custom work

estimated_time.description: Estimated time of the custom work

is_recurring.description: Whether the custom work is recurring

type_frequency.description: Type of frequency for recurring works

specific_day.description: Specific day for recurring works (required if is_recurring is true)

plugin_keys.description: Array of plugin keys to process

post.description: Optimizes the database for a specific project. At least one optimization option must be enabled.

example.message: At least one optimization option must be enabled

get.description: Retrieves a single project by its ID.

example.message: You are not authorized to access this resource.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of plugins for a specific project.

post.description: Updates one or more plugins for a specific project. Returns a process ID to track the update.

plugin_keys.description: Array of plugin keys to update

clear_cache.description: Whether to clear cache after update

advanced_safe_update_validation.description: Enable advanced validation for safe updates
